_comment: Single source of truth for the URL the iOS WKWebView loads. Selected by name via the APP_TARGET env var (see apps/web/capacitor.config.ts). Nothing else may hard-code these URLs: capacitor.config.ts, apps/web/scripts/ios-local.sh and scripts/local-status.sh all read this file. To point at a new environment, add a target here rather than editing any script.

local.note: iOS Simulator only. On a real device 127.0.0.1 is the device itself, not your Mac.

staging.note: Vercel alias for the staging git branch. This is the committed default, so a plain Xcode Run is always staging.

production.note: Public production runtime. Release builds only; Debug builds must remain on staging or local.
